anchored_claim: On Wiki-Squirrel, WormNet-v3, and CA-Netscience, PDP_RSC and ADP_RSC are reported to outperform PDP_Comp and ADP_Comp by 3 to 4 orders of magnitude in accuracy at query-set size Theta(n^2).
falsification_basis: The proposition is an attribution about the contents of Section 5. The complete pinned section assigns ceil(n^1.5) to the default accuracy protocol and assigns both 3-to-4-order statements and Theta(n^2) to the later Runtime scope.

runtime_protocol.measurement: sample query times until relative standard error < 5%
runtime_protocol.reported_hardware: Intel Xeon Platinum 8562Y at 2.80 GHz with 768 GB RAM
runtime_protocol.theta_n2_total_time: extrapolated from mean query time plus preprocessing
